description: This PHP source file defines the Upgrade9 class, which is part of the OpenCart installation upgrade process. The class manages database entries for various system features during an upgrade, specifically for version 9, by checking and inserting records into the 'ssr' table, and then prepares a JSON response indicating progress and next steps.

classes.name: Upgrade9
classes.description: Handles the database upgrade steps for version 9, including inserting missing 'ssr' entries and providing JSON feedback.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method executed during the upgrade step, performing database operations and returning JSON status.
